headline: Q2 net profit rises 33% to Rs 975 crore
what_happened: L&T Finance Limited has announced: L&T Finance reported a 33% increase in consolidated net profit for the quarter ending September 30, 2026. The company's consolidated loan book rose 28% year-on-year to reach Rs 1.36 lakh crore. Net interest margin improved to 10.48%, while total income increased by 26% to Rs 5,484 crore. Asset quality also showed improvement, with gross non-performing loans declining to 2.7%.
